pages.text: A pale forest of $(l)marrow trees$() on ossified nylium. When the ceiling is close, trunks fuse with it into natural pillars. Glowing $(item)Marrow Vines$() hang from the caps and can be climbed.$(br2)Resources: Marrow wood, $(item)Marrow Caps$() (turned into $(item)Marrow Meal$()), bones.
